## Entries

For each item, record:

- **Name and syntax:** exact spelling and source-backed form.
- **Arguments and result:** types, ranges, and return behavior when established.
- **Semantics:** observable behavior and evaluation rules.
- **Side effects:** state changes, I/O, resource ownership, or errors.
- **Availability:** platform, dialect, and version scope.
- **Implementation status:** separate from source evidence; identify whether it is not implemented, experimental, or verified by project tests.
- **Evidence:** source ID, edition/version, printed page or section, and any uncertainty.

Do not infer a signature or behavior from another BASIC dialect or platform.

## Differences and unresolved questions

List conflicting sources, OCR-sensitive details, unverified behavior, and required experiments. Do not silently choose one interpretation.

## Examples and tests

Use independently authored examples. Identify the dialect/version and required API profile. Link a conformance test only when its expected behavior has an adequate source or trusted interpreter basis.
